name: Jubvo – AI Chatbot & Live Chat Assistant
author: erkancam001

sections.description:
Jubvo is an AI chatbot and live chat assistant for your website. It answers your visitors 24/7 in their own language (40+ languages) using your own pages and documents, handles customer support questions, and captures leads (name, email, WhatsApp) — automatically.

This plugin only embeds the Jubvo widget on your site. Bot creation, training, and all appearance and behavior settings are managed from the Jubvo panel at https://jubvo.com.

Features

  • One-click setup — you only enter a Bot ID.
  • Color, name, welcome message, WhatsApp, position, theme and all other options are managed from the Jubvo panel and applied automatically, so the panel and the plugin never conflict.
  • Automatic replies in 40+ languages.
  • Lightweight — loaded at the bottom of the page, so it does not slow your site down.

External services

This plugin connects to Jubvo (https://jubvo.com), a third-party AI chat service, to provide its core and clearly described functionality.

What it does: When a site administrator enters a “Bot ID” and enables the plugin, it loads the Jubvo chat widget script (https://jubvo.com/widget.js) on the site’s front end.

What data is sent and when: Only when a visitor interacts with the chat bubble and sends a message. The visitor’s typed messages and any image or PDF files they upload are sent to Jubvo’s servers to generate a reply. The plugin does not send any personal data automatically before a visitor starts a chat. On the admin side, the plugin only embeds the widget script with the Bot ID; it does not collect or send any other data.

Terms of Use: https://jubvo.com/sartlar.html
Privacy Policy: https://jubvo.com/gizlilik.html
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings -> Jubvo AI Assistant.
  3. In your Jubvo panel (https://jubvo.com/botlarim.html -> Publish -> Sites / Embed Codes), copy your Bot ID.
  4. Paste it into the Bot ID field and click Save.
  5. Open your site — the chat bubble appears in the bottom corner.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Bot ID?

In your Jubvo panel, under Publish -> Sites / Embed Codes, the value inside data-bot="..." is your Bot ID.

I do not have a Jubvo account. Does this plugin work on its own?

No. This plugin connects to the Jubvo service. You first need to create a free account at https://jubvo.com and set up a bot.

Where do I change settings such as color, name or WhatsApp?

All of them are managed from your Jubvo panel (the Design and Publish sections) and applied to the site automatically. The plugin has no separate appearance settings, so the panel and the plugin never conflict.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Change: The in-plugin appearance and behavior settings (color, name, welcome message, WhatsApp, position, theme, sound, corner radius, widget style) were removed. They conflicted with the panel and are now managed only from the Jubvo panel and applied automatically. The plugin now keeps only the Bot ID and an on/off toggle, plus a button that opens the panel.
  • Note: Existing installations are not affected — old in-plugin values are ignored and the panel settings apply.

1.2.1

  • Fix: Resolved an issue where the chat bubble could fail to appear with some themes and cache/optimization plugins (JS defer/combine). The widget now loads exactly like the official embed code (synchronously) and locates its script tag more reliably.

1.2.0

  • New: “Widget style” option — choose a classic chat bubble or an animated mascot character.

1.1.0

  • New: Position (bottom right or left), light/dark theme, corner radius and notification sound options.
  • New: Visual color picker for the widget color.
  • Improvement: Stricter validation for the Bot ID, color and WhatsApp fields.
  • Improvement: The widget loads asynchronously; settings are cleared when the plugin is deleted.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
